mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any asset, tangible or intangible, acquired for retention by an entity for the purpose of providing a service to the organisation, and not held for resale in the normal course of trading."

Non-Current asset (Fixed Asset) is any asset, tangible or intangible, acquired for retention by an entity for the purpose of providing a service to the organisation, and not held for resale in the normal course of trading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a record, in columnar format, of small cash payments made on a day-to-day basis."
The petty cash book is a record, in columnar format, of small cash payments made on a day-to-day basis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total profit the cooperative received from providing goods and services to members that can be used for business expenses."
Gross Revenue is the total profit the cooperative received from providing goods and services to members that can be used for business expenses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the motto of a Co-operative Society."
Service rather than profit is the motto of a Co-operative Society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means by which auditors express their opinion on truth and fairness of a company's financial statement for the benefits principally of the shareholders, but also for other users."

The audit report is a means by which auditors express their opinion on truth and fairness of a company's financial statement for the benefits principally of the shareholders, but also for other users.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those paid within 1 year such as Accounts Payable, Short-Term operating loans, or the current portion of Long-Term loans."
Current Liabilities are those paid within 1 year such as Accounts Payable, Short-Term operating loans, or the current portion of Long-Term loans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those incurred in one period of account and whose full benefit is consumed within the same period."
Revenue expenditure are those incurred in one period of account and whose full benefit is consumed within the same period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the costs incurred to provide services to members."
Expenses are the costs incurred to provide services to members.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Naira amount earned by the cooperative from operations."
Revenue is the Naira amount earned by the cooperative from operations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any person appointed by the Government either at the Federal or State level to superintend over the activities, operations and processes of cooperative societies in Nigeria."

A Director of Cooperatives is any person appointed by the Government either at the Federal or State level to superintend over the activities, operations and processes of cooperative societies in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means to comply with relevant laws and regulations and avoid any action that discredits the profession."
Professional behaviour means to comply with relevant laws and regulations and avoid any action that discredits the profession.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a list of all the balances in the ledger."
The trial balance is a list of all the balances in the ledger.
fib: ______ is an audit conducted under the statute and therefore, it is statutory in character.
Co-operative Audit
Co-operative Audit is an audit conducted under the statute and therefore, it is statutory in character.
______ is a method of recording and reporting the financial results of its business transactions.
cooperative Society's accounting system
The cooperative Society's accounting system is a method of recording and reporting the financial results of its business transactions.
______ means that the cooperative auditor should not allow bias, conflict of interest or undue influence of others to override professional or business judgments.
Objectivity
Objectivity means that the cooperative auditor should not allow bias, conflict of interest or undue influence of others to override professional or business judgments.
______ is a temporary account that is used to correct errors that affects the trial balance.
suspense account
A suspense account is a temporary account that is used to correct errors that affects the trial balance.
______ is the only alternative to protect the weaker sections of the society and to protect the economic interest of the people.
cooperative society
The cooperative society is the only alternative to protect the weaker sections of the society and to protect the economic interest of the people.
______ is used to report the financial position of the cooperative at a given point in time, usually at the end of a month, quarter, or year.
Statement of Financial Position
The Statement of Financial Position is used to report the financial position of the cooperative at a given point in time, usually at the end of a month, quarter, or year.
______ is a society of people with its main objects as promotion of economic and social interests of its members by means of common undertaking.
cooperative
A cooperative is a society of people with its main objects as promotion of economic and social interests of its members by means of common undertaking.
______ is the element over which business owners and managers have the most control.
Opportunity
Opportunity is the element over which business owners and managers have the most control.
______ are used to evaluate past operations and are the basis for management and operating decisions on future projects.
Financial reports
Financial reports are used to evaluate past operations and are the basis for management and operating decisions on future projects.
______ is an account which contains the summary of entries in the individual accounts in each ledger.
control account
A control account is an account which contains the summary of entries in the individual accounts in each ledger.
______ is the main or principal book of account where accounts are maintained for income, assets, expenses as well as individuals (or organisations) who may be debtors or creditors to the firm.
ledger
The ledger is the main or principal book of account where accounts are maintained for income, assets, expenses as well as individuals (or organisations) who may be debtors or creditors to the firm.
